primary_endpoint: paired median process CPU reduction in actual production save()
success_gate: At least one large plain workload: >=5% paired CPU reduction, >=10/12 faster pairs, positive CPU medians in both execution orders, no wall regression. Remaining large-rich workloads: nonnegative paired CPU medians and no clear wall regression.
ordinary_playlist_gate: Reject a repeated >=5% CPU or wall slowdown in 24-item saves, especially if both execution-order strata are negative.
interpretation: Report wall and marginal medians too. No improvement is required in rich fixtures dominated by unchanged string/URL encoding, but any regression must be resolved. No pooling of exploratory and confirmation samples; no further repetition to chase favorable results.
small_controls: 0/1-item timings may remain storage-noise-dominated; do not claim zero overhead or a small-playlist speedup without support.
